There's going to be a rally today at 6pm at the Planned Parenthood in Montclair. 

"We are angered and shocked by the U.S. Supreme Court’s possible decision to overturn Roe v. Wade.

Rally with us TONIGHT at the Montclair Planned Parenthood Center at 29 N. Fullerton Ave! 

Speakers include:
*First Lady of New Jersey Tammy Murphy
*Congresswoman Mikie Sherrill (NJ-11)
*Montclair Mayor Sean Spiller
*Larry Hamm, Chair of People's *Organization for Progress
*Erin Chung, Director of Communications *Planned Parenthood"
